name: Bubble Bakery
source:
Maintaining a bakery underwater is no easy task.

Your debt has increased further than what you can face, and soon you'll have to close the bakery.

But it's Christmas Eve, and you feel it would be wrong to leave the townspeople without sweets on a day like this.

Open the bakery for one last time, meet the picturesque customers, and enjoy the magic of Christmas.

[From [url=https://kthxsayonara.itch.io/bubble-bakery]itch.io[/url]]
